answer.rationale: Incumbent will not reopen price and the primary contract lapses in 14 days with no auto-renewal, so deferral or another negotiation pass will neither hit the 18% spend cut nor clearly secure continuity. The low-cost quote meets the mandate on its own; memory_c2 reports a prior primary move to that vendor cut unit cost with fast onboarding and clean invoicing, which is the only inherited path that jointly addresses cost and an expiring primary. memory_c1 is the main counterweight: incumbent renewal avoided migration and delivery interruption, which matters at 94% utilization with no buffer. Verifying those two records before commit. Dual-source (memory_c3) would reduce SPOF risk but is a single decision that does not replace the expiring primary or deliver the mandated savings alone. Flagging line-stop / downstream value risk if onboarding overruns the 14-day window; treating prior onboarding speed as uncertain until the archive is checked.
